rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL owns the freshest and most concentrated idiosyncratic catalyst stack in majors right now. Spot Solana ETFs are LEADING flows while peers bleed: ~$33M of weekly inflows (incl. a ~$6.7M single-session add) pushed cumulative spot-SOL-ETF inflows above $1B since the Oct-2025 launch, even as broad crypto-ETF flows were net-negative in early July. On-chain, Solana captured ~96% of ALL on-chain tokenized-equity trading in June (a historic high), and Securitize tokenized ~$295M of NYSE-listed common stock on Solana — a real, growing RWA demand base tied to the chain rather than to beta. Governance just leveled up too: the Solana Foundation launched a formal on-chain validator-voting framework, boosting decentralization credibility and long-term-holder confidence, with the Alpenglow consensus upgrade lined up as a potential Q3 catalyst. On the tape SOL is holding ~$76-77 and firming while ETH is the structural laggard, and entry $76.97 sits well below the $80/$83 resistance shelf — the asymmetric 'fresh catalyst + relative strength with a definable stop' setup the mandate prefers.
positions.driver: Rotate ETH → SOL. ETH just closed +$92.63 but remains the 6-month structural laggard (~-22% vs BTC) losing DeFi/MEV share to Solana, and its ETF bid is concentrated/fragile. SOL carries the cleaner asymmetric payoff: multi-pronged fresh catalysts (ETF-flow leadership vs a bleeding peer group, 96% tokenized-equity dominance + $295M Securitize RWA, new on-chain governance, Alpenglow ahead) plus firming relative strength, with entry $76.97 leaving room to the $80/$83 shelf while $74-75 support defines invalidation. Runners-up rejected: BTC (~$64,890) — flow leader again (spot-BTC ETFs snapped a 10-day losing streak with a ~$221.7M haul, largest in two months) and the lower-beta protective major, but no fresh idiosyncratic catalyst and lower expected next-24h payoff; ETH (~$1,888) — green today but the flow reversal is narrow/BlackRock-concentrated and it keeps stalling below key EMAs, a live sell-the-news risk.
positions.risks: SOL is the higher-beta major, so it falls hardest if the risk-on tape rolls over (F&G only recently off 26/Fear; social volume near 2-year lows) or on a hawkish/geopolitical shock. Its ETF-flow leadership is still small in absolute dollars and can reverse in a single session; the RWA/tokenized-equity narrative is real but early and headline-sensitive. Technically SOL faces stacked resistance at $80/$83/$90 and has repeatedly failed near $74-75 support on the downside — a clean break of $74-75 invalidates the thesis regardless of the stop. Hard stop $69.27 (-10%, higher-beta alt rule) set below the $74-75 support shelf with wick room; a decisive close under $74-75 means the trade is wrong.
